bundle.shortDescription: Fully-featured P2P encrypted messenger over Tor
bundle.longDescription: Vchat is a peer-to-peer encrypted messenger that routes all traffic through the Tor network. No servers, no tracking, no metadata collection. Features include text messaging, group chats, voice/video calls, screen sharing, file transfers, emoji reactions, disappearing messages, and more. Messages are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, key exchange uses X25519 ECDH, and the Noise protocol provides mutual authentication.
